categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in internet retail focusing on apparel and accessories, including women's and men's clothing, jewelry, and home textiles. It engages in product planning and design, supply chain management, and online sales mainly through platforms like Taobao and Tmall. The company also develops live streaming sales channels to enhance consumer engagement.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a flexible supply chain with three production modes: partial outsourcing where materials are procured and sent to suppliers for processing, full outsourcing where suppliers handle materials and production, and self-production for certain garments. It uses data-driven marketing and lean supply chain management to optimize inventory and product offerings. Information management systems support end-to-end processes from design to delivery, including intelligent raw material management and integration with logistics platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are end consumers purchasing mid-to-high-end apparel and accessories online, predominantly women. The company serves the Chinese domestic market with a focus on internet retail consumers who value high-quality, cost-effective fashion products. It also targets consumers interested in jewelry and home textile products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with sales distributed across key regions including East China, North China, Southwest, South China, Central China, Northeast, and Northwest. The majority of revenue comes from East China, followed by North China and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product planning, design, supply chain management, and retail sales. It outsources most manufacturing and logistics operations to specialized suppliers and third-party logistics providers, maintaining control over core design and supply chain coordination.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product design and development capabilities, upgrading information systems to support new retail models, expanding live streaming sales and related teams, and establishing offline experience stores to complement online channels. The company invests in R&D centers focusing on fashion trends and consumer preferences, and embraces AI and digital technologies to improve inventory management and marketing efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct online sales of apparel, jewelry, and related products via e-commerce platforms. The company leverages vertical integration to reduce intermediaries, enabling competitive pricing. Additional revenue streams include live streaming sales and rental income from leasing properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading internet apparel brand retailer in China, recognized for high product quality and cost-effectiveness. It competes with other mid-to-high-end fashion brands and online retailers, leveraging strong brand loyalty, extensive customer base, and efficient supply chain management. It ranks among the top in profitability within the Chinese apparel industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 689 million, a 10.2% decrease from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 25.95% to about RMB 107 million. The company maintains a strong cash flow position and continues to invest in infrastructure and R&D. Despite some revenue decline due to market conditions, profitability and operational efficiency have improved.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective fashion products with a focus on mid-to-high-end materials sourced globally, including premium cashmere, silk, and rare fibers. It differentiates through agile supply chain management enabling rapid product updates and small batch production, strong online brand presence, and immersive live streaming sales that enhance customer experience. Its integrated information systems and data analytics enable precise consumer targeting and inventory optimization.
